title: Sumrall Says Florida's Offense Must Find Its Rhythm Before Texas
excerpt: Florida's head coach met the media Sunday after the 38-19 loss to South Carolina and laid out what has to change on offense before the Gators visit Texas. Here is what he said, and what it means for Saturday.
